text: This might be silly so apologies in advance. My daughter is 3 and she's got a blotchy pinkish rash on her chest and arms. I did the glass test because that's what everyone says to do, and it does go pale under the glass, it fades right out, so I was relieved about that. The thing that's bugging me is her neck. When I asked her to look down at her belly button, which is usually a game she loves, she just wouldn't, kept her head up and stiff and said no. I tried a toy on the floor too and she won't tip her head down to look at it, she bends from the waist instead or just ignores it. Maybe she's just being stubborn, she's three after all, but it seemed odd enough that I thought I'd ask rather than lie awake wondering. Her mum's asleep and I didn't want to wake her if it's nothing.
